messages:
maria: FYI found a Vault token leaking in a GitHub Actions runner log for infra/ci-runner. Saw VAULT_TOKEN printed in debug output. Pinging sec & ops.

chris: link to run: https://github.com/redwood/infra/actions/runs/1234567890 — thanks for the flag. Is the repo public?

maria: repo is internal but logs were uploaded to the run artifact (not public), still needs rotation. devsec-bot already created a ticket.

devsec-bot: Automated alert: pattern matched for secret-like blob in action logs. Ticket created: SEC-3421.

maria: quick grep I ran: ```grep -n "VAULT_TOKEN" artifacts/* | head``` showed partial token fragments: `s.XyZabc123...` Not the full token in stdout but enough to be a risk.

leo: Do we know how long-lived that token is and what issued it?

anya: Investigated: token came from AppRole for ci-runner. Historically TTL was 24h but a recent change increased some workflows to 7d for long jobs.

chris: Action list (short): 1) rotate AppRole secret_id + revoke current tokens, 2) scrub/remove artifacts/logs from GH, 3) tighten TTL, 4) RBAC restrict which repos can request this role, 5) enable KMS-wrapped storage for secret backups.

maria: I can rotate and revoke now. Running: ```vault write -f auth/approle/role/ci-runner/secret-id``` then `vault write auth/approle/role/ci-runner/secret-id <new>` to issue. Will also hit /auth/token/revoke-self for any leaked token IDs we can find.

ops-oncall: I'll temporarily block the CI job: disabling the workflow trigger for infra/ci-runner until rotation done. Setting env to blank on the runner so any pending jobs fail fast.

samir: After rotate, let's enable KMS wrapping for the approle secret blob storage and make sure snapshots are encrypted with customer KMS and not accessible in plaintext. I'll prepare the Vault config snippet for wrapping.

leo: We should also add an approle-bound constraint: require metadata of repo name and SHA in the request so only signed runs can fetch secrets. That reduces blast radius.

anya: Also push a change to set AppRole TTL to 1h for CI and ensure renewals only for active runners. I can open a PR.

chris: I'll contact GH support about removing the artifact content or expiring it immediately; file a request referencing run id and SEC-3421. If they can't fully remove, we'll rotate again.

maria: Rotation in progress — revoking secret_id and issuing new one. ETA ~20–30m. :lock:

devsec-bot: SEC-3421 status: in_progress. Evidence attachments: run-1234567890-screenshot.txt (redacted).

chris: After rotation, run a repo-wide search for similar patterns: `rg "VAULT_TOKEN|VAULT_ADDR" -S repo/*` and remove any `set -x` debug lines in workflows. I'll open a cross-repo cleanup PR template.

maria: Note: root cause was a Vault agent sidecar configured with `-debug` which printed token on error. I submitted a PR to remove debug and to avoid echoing env in error handlers: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/987.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor auth logs for anomalous token usage spikes for the next 24h and escalate if we see unknown usage.

samir: Postmortem items: audit log retention for AppRole events (enable forwarding to secure SIEM), enforce KMS wrapping on backup exports, and add a CI policy requiring ephemeral tokens. I'll create a tracking ticket.

anya: Assignments: maria rotate/revoke, chris scrub & GH contact, ops-oncall block + monitor, samir KMS wrapping + audit config, leo RBAC limitation PR, anya TTL + workflow PR.

maria: Will update SEC-3421 with steps and evidence as I finish. Thanks everyone.

chris: Quick reminder — rotate any service accounts that might have used the approle creds as a precaution.

maria: Confirmed rotation done at 4765432175. New secret issued, old tokens revoked. Updating ticket.

devsec-bot: SEC-3421 updated: status=mitigated, assignees=[maria,chris,samir,leo,anya,ops-oncall].

maria: Closing note: make sure any debug `set -x` is avoided in future. Will follow up in infra-runbook with explicit safe logging rules.

ops-oncall: Monitoring in place. No abnormal auth attempts so far.

leo: I'll land the RBAC PR after tests.

anya: I'll push the TTL change and docs. Follow-up audit scheduled next week. :white_check_mark:
